note: FROZEN PREREGISTRATION. Thresholds, scenarios, strata and metric definitions below are fixed before dependent implementation. Measured values are filled by ci-baseline w2 remeasurement under these frozen definitions; any later criteria change requires a criteria_version bump and disclosure, never silent application to a measured cohort. The registration commit is bound externally (introducing-commit digest in commit message and batch ledger), not inside this file, to avoid a self-referential commit field.

historical_cohort.window: trailing 28 days of merged develop PRs ending at registration
historical_cohort.unit: one legitimate merged develop PR, complete lifecycle
historical_cohort.completeness: every synchronize head SHA and every workflow run attempt per PR, including cancelled and superseded runs; merge_group and post-merge runs correlated separately, never credited to the authored head
historical_cohort.missing_evidence_policy: expired/incomplete artifact observations are quantified as missing with explicit missing-artifact status, never silently excluded and never counted as green

metric_definitions.avoidable_action: one authored push whose tree equals its parent feature tree and only moves the base (ancestry-only refresh), or one local validation execution duplicated against an identical already-completed input identity
metric_definitions.denominator: equivalent delivered outcomes over the cohort window, counting worker plus integration work, local plus hosted checks, all heads and attempts, cancellations, abandoned work and human effort; fewer PRs or a shorter post-open interval alone is not a saving

thresholds.safety: no added required-lane failure and no weakened trust boundary attributable to coordination
thresholds.p95: no measured medium-test p95 regression attributable to coordination

prospective_cohort.human_hold: at least one operator-approved soundness flow held until its real approval

batch_deliveries.counting: a batch delivery counts toward the PR cohort as the PRs it lands as, never as one sample per member

prospective_cohort.insufficiency_policy: missing strata or observations keep acceptance insufficient; no fabricated traffic and no synthetic canaries

prior_evidence_disclosed.concurrency_audit: 195 merged PRs: 0.27 cancelled vs 15682.1 completed runner-minutes on final heads; 15 superseded pushes averaged 42.5 runner-minutes discarded mid-flight (_project/audits/develop-pr-concurrency-2026-09-06.md); final-head-only aggregates do not prove whole-lifecycle cost
prior_evidence_disclosed.refresh_shadow_snapshot: single-afternoon sample, 3 shadow_eligible first-refresh hits; weak, not a skip-safety measure
prior_evidence_disclosed.skill_lane: one legitimate sample (PR #1996); durable budget requires three
prior_evidence_disclosed.pre_lane_baseline: behind-pr-occurrence-02 / PR #1756, 2026-08-14 through 2026-08-17 interarrival p50 31.3 minutes

feature_batch_preregistration.comparison_units: feature-start-to-land lead time and total agent/user effort per equivalent delivered outcome, including assembly, worker plus integration validation, cancelled/abandoned work and backlog throughput

change_policy: Any criteria change after registration is a new criteria_version with a disclosed diff; measured cohorts are never re-scored under changed criteria.
